description: This PHP class `Language` within the `Opencart` framework manages language data for stores in an admin task context. It includes methods to generate language lists, save these as JSON files, and clear existing language files for different stores.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Generates, retrieves, and clears language data files for stores in the Opencart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a task for each store to list their language data and returns success message.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves language configurations for a specific store and generates a JSON file with language data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated language JSON files for all stores and languages.
